items.item_text: 3+ years of professional full-stack software development experience, including designing, developing, maintaining and troubleshooting applications in a production environment using secure coding practices and AI tools.
Experience with automated testing frameworks, continuous integration/continuous delivery pipelines, and DevOps tools.
Experience creating reusable libraries or UI components, participating in pair programming and code reviews, and ensuring maintainable, accessible, and high-quality code.
Familiarity with containerization (e.g., Docker/Kubernetes), cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and infrastructure-as-code tools.

Demonstrated proficiency using AI-assisted development tools to work more efficiently across the software development lifecycle, including the ability to critically evaluate, test, and validate AI-generated code, and to apply responsible practices for data privacy, security, and institutional policy.
